content.text: Tough day, sad day. When we find out arrangements we will see how the family wants to communicate
Going to miss him. Had a number of personal conversations with him in the past 11 years and never took it for granted. A living legend in every way.
I can imagine. I am sorry for your loss. Thank you for getting back to me
Also: We are doing a special section for Thursday. I’m going to reach out to Al to see if he wants to expand on his relationship with Al.
